Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy (error rate 0.18) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Deployment history showed v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were the last healthy production releases; v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy (staging).
2. **Rolled back** to the most recent healthy production release, **v2.3.0**, in all regions. The first rollback attempt partially completed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error, so I retried and the rollback completed across all three regions.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback.

**Final state:** checkout-api is now on **v2.3.0** in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), **healthy** with error rate 0.002. Incident INC-0001 remains open for follow-up investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.
